title: Referendum
snippet: Superintendent of Schools Maryadele Wojtowicz, Board of Education President Dear West Essex School Community, Providing safe and secure schools remains one of the district’s highest priorities, and the proposed referendum reflects that commitment. Several projects included in the proposal are designed to strengthen school security while maintaining welcoming and supportive learning environments for our students and staff. School safety and security projects qualify for the maximum level of state aid. As a result, approximately one-third of the eligible project costs would be covered by the state, helping to reduce the impact on local taxpayers. This state aid is available only with voter approval of the referendum. Proposed upgrades include secure entrance vestibules at both schools, replacement of aging exterior and interior doors, updated door hardware, and keyless access systems fully integrated with the district’s security network. These enhancements reflect current school safety best practices and would provide staff with greater control over building access while strengthening the district’s ability to respond effectively in an emergency. They would also allow designated areas of our schools to be secured quickly when necessary.
